name: obsidian-canvas-web-optimizer
description: Optimize web pages in Obsidian Canvas with cached previews and smarter webview resource management.

scripts.format: biome format --write src tests test-runner.mjs package.json manifest.json
scripts.check: biome check src tests test-runner.mjs && tsc
scripts.build: pnpm run test && pnpm run check && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: ibbuilds
